_note:
Reading paths for the Start here page (task 19a). Each step points at a chapter (

-ch), a range of chapters (ref .. to), a poem (-poem) or a row id; the website turns the ids into links with the titles. Notes per interface language. English by the editor; the Icelandic is a draft (status.is) until a native reader has checked it. Correct here, never on the page.

note.en: Gylfi visits the Æsir; the creation of the world, Yggdrasill, the gods and their dwellings.
note.is: Gylfi heimsækir æsi; sköpun heimsins, Yggdrasill, goðin og bústaðir þeirra.

note.en: The seeress tells the whole story, from the void to the new earth, in 66 stanzas.
note.is: Völvan segir alla söguna, frá tóminu til nýrrar jarðar, í 66 erindum.

note.en: Baldr's death, Loki's punishment, Ragnarök and what comes after.
note.is: Dauði Baldurs, refsing Loka, ragnarök og það sem á eftir kemur.

note.en: The rest of Gylfaginning: the gods one by one, Þórr's journey to Útgarða-Loki, the binding of Fenrir.
note.is: Afgangurinn af Gylfaginningu: goðin hvert af öðru, för Þórs til Útgarða-Loka, Fenrir bundinn.

note.en: Ægir's feast, Þjazi carries off Iðunn, the mead of poetry.
note.is: Veisla Ægis, Þjazi rænir Iðunni, skáldskaparmjöðurinn.

note.en: Þórr against Hrungnir, the seeress Gróa, the journey to Geirröðr.
note.is: Þór gegn Hrungni, völvan Gróa, förin til Geirröðar.

note.en: The Æsir at Ægir's, the grove Glasir, the treasures the dwarfs made.
note.is: Æsir hjá Ægi, lundurinn Glasir, gripirnir sem dvergarnir smíðuðu.

note.en: Þórr dressed as a bride wins back his hammer.
note.is: Þór í brúðarbúningi vinnur hamarinn aftur.

note.en: Þórr fishes for the Miðgarðsormr.
note.is: Þór veiðir Miðgarðsorm.

note.en: Loki insults every god at Ægir's feast.
note.is: Loki smánar hvert goð í veislu Ægis.

note.en: Skírnir woos Gerðr for Freyr.
note.is: Skírnir biður Gerðar fyrir Frey.

note.en: Óðinn's counsel: how to live, how to love, how he won the runes.
note.is: Ráð Óðins: hvernig á að lifa, elska og hvernig hann nam rúnirnar.

note.en: Óðinn's wisdom contest with the giant Vafþrúðnir.
note.is: Spekikeppni Óðins við jötuninn Vafþrúðni.

note.en: Óðinn between the fires names the halls of the gods.
note.is: Óðinn milli eldanna telur upp bústaði goðanna.

note.en: Þórr keeps the dwarf Alvíss talking until sunrise.
note.is: Þór heldur dvergnum Alvís á tali fram að sólarupprás.

title.en: The heroes: Sigurðr and the Niflungs

note.en: Snorri's retelling as a summary: the otter's ransom, Fáfnir, Sigurðr, the Gjúkungs, Guðrún's revenge.
note.is: Endursögn Snorra sem yfirlit: otrgjöldin, Fáfnir, Sigurður, Gjúkungar, hefnd Guðrúnar.

note.en: Reginn, the gold and the curse.
note.is: Reginn, gullið og bölvunin.

note.en: Sigurðr kills Fáfnir and learns the birds' speech.
note.is: Sigurður vegur Fáfni og skilur mál fuglanna.

note.en: The valkyrie's rune lore.
note.is: Rúnafræði valkyrjunnar.

note.en: The fragment: Sigurðr's death.
note.is: Brotið: dauði Sigurðar.

note.en: Guðrún's grief.
note.is: Harmur Guðrúnar.

note.en: Guðrún's story, told to Þjóðrekr.
note.is: Saga Guðrúnar, sögð Þjóðreki.

note.en: Guðrún's ordeal.
note.is: Skírsla Guðrúnar.

note.en: Atli's invitation and the end of the Gjúkungs.
note.is: Boð Atla og endalok Gjúkunga.

note.en: The same story told at length.
note.is: Sama saga sögð ítarlega.

note.en: Guðrún urges her sons to avenge Svanhildr.
note.is: Guðrún eggjar syni sína að hefna Svanhildar.

note.en: Hamðir and Sörli at Jörmunrekkr's hall.
note.is: Hamðir og Sörli í höll Jörmunrekks.

note.en: What a kenning is; Snorri's words to young poets.
note.is: Hvað kenning er; orð Snorra til ungra skálda.

note.en: Kennings for the gods, with the verses that use them.
note.is: Kenningar goðanna með vísunum sem nota þær.

note.en: Kennings for the goddesses, the sky, the earth, the sea, men and gold.
note.is: Kenningar gyðjanna, himins, jarðar, sjávar, manna og gulls.

note.en: More kennings, then the heiti: the word lists of the poets.
note.is: Fleiri kenningar, síðan heitin: orðalistar skáldanna.

note.en: Háttatal: 102 stanzas, one for each metre, with Snorri's commentary.
note.is: Háttatal: 102 erindi, eitt fyrir hvern hátt, með skýringum Snorra.
